sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows aztreonam is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 261 vials of the 1 g injection at 13.2 vials per day, providing 19.8 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 255 vials at 15.4 vials per day, providing 16.5 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 42 vials at 4.1 vials per day, providing 10.1 days on hand.
The rule-ranked first alternate manufacturer is E.R. Squibb & Sons, L.L.C., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and uses the Bristol-Myers Squibb Company Princeton plant.
A second alternate is Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, also not on the shortage list, whose plant last received a VAI classification on 2023-10-13.
A third alternate is Hospira, Inc., not on the shortage list, though its label names no plant we could place.
